description: This file defines the ViewLanguages class for handling language management in the SuiteCRM administration module. It includes methods for displaying language settings, ensuring administrative access, and rendering the language interface.

classes.name: ViewLanguages
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to manage language settings in the admin interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the module title, providing a link to the administration index.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin privileges before displaying the page.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the language management interface, determining enabled and disabled languages.
